port_name: BEHAVIOR-1K v3.9.2 + upstream isaac-6.0-upgrade patch, registered for Isaac Sim 6.1.0
local_deviations: simulator.py: m.KIT_FILES also maps (6,1,0) -> omnigibson_6_0_0.kit (upstream branch only lists 6.0.0/6.0.1)
envs/__init__.py: lerobot wrappers imported inside try/except (lerobot not installed; not used by eval)
bddl installed from third_party/BEHAVIOR-1K/bddl3 (v3.9.2 tree, version 3.7.0); joylo from this tree

eval/utils/network_utils.py: remove sync-client ping_interval/ping_timeout unsupported by websockets 14.2; server keepalive remains enabled. setup.py pins websockets>=14.2,<15 to match isaacsim-kernel 6.1.0.0; upstream OmniGibson requires >=15.0.1.
why: Isaac Sim 5.1 (official v3.9.2 pin) segfaults in rtx.scenedb at viewport creation on driver 595.91.07 / RTX 5060 Ti (Blackwell) in 5/5 headless attempts; Isaac Sim 6.1 renders headless on this machine (outputs/behavior/isaac_probe/probe_isaac61_timeline.json)
not_official: Scores from this port are NOT official challenge scores (different Isaac/PhysX/renderer versions). Use for development; report the deviation.

websocket_compatibility.reason: Isaac Sim 6.1 kernel requires >=12,<15; OmniGibson v3.9.2 client used v15-only sync keepalive options. This local port retains the Isaac dependency and compatible websocket protocol.
websocket_compatibility.limitation: Client no longer initiates periodic keepalive pings; the server keeps its default ping/pong behavior. This is not a simulator-success or policy-quality check.

local_evaluator_changes.change: --log-object-poses (opt-in, default off): evaluator-side per-step ground-truth pose log

OmniGibson/omnigibson/eval/eval.py.what: new argparse flag --log-object-poses (BooleanOptionalAction, default False); when set, start_pose_log() after reset and stop_pose_log() in the rollout finally block; nothing else changed

OmniGibson/omnigibson/eval/evaluator.py.what: Evaluator.start_pose_log/_write_pose_log/stop_pose_log (+ small helpers), mirroring start_joint_log: writes <output-dir>/object_poses/<task>_<instance>_<rollout>.jsonl with a header (privileged_data_use: evaluator-side evidence only; never policy input; entity names/categories, AABB at reset, native bbox, scale; BDDL ground goal literals; camera intrinsics and the cam_rel_poses camera order) and one row per environment step: world pose [x,y,z,qx,qy,qz,qw] of every task-scope object (systems, floors and the agent entry skipped), the robot base pose (robot.get_position_orientation, the base used for cam_rel_poses) and the per-literal BDDL goal truth (only when <= 64 literals). step() calls _write_pose_log(), a no-op unless the log was started

local_evaluator_changes.privileged_data_use: evaluator-side evidence only; never policy input (nothing is added to the observation sent to the policy)
local_evaluator_changes.purpose: Task 1 picking_up_trash demo-action replay diagnostic: physical ground truth for cans inside the ashcan and for offline perception development (aligned with sim-native RGB-D frames); not an official challenge feature
